_readme: The current leadership team, shown on /executive/. TO DO THE ANNUAL ROLLOVER: change 'year', then edit the entries. 'photo' is an optional filename inside public/images/exec/ (e.g. "kyle.jpg"); if the file is missing or the field is empty, a styled crest placeholder is shown instead - nothing breaks. Order in this file is display order.
